title: AcSh history adapter capture bounds fast slice
mode: Local adapter implementation with generated focused validation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Bound the concrete dwg2dxf adapter's typed AcSh history callback copies before retention.
Fail closed on record/byte budget refusal or allocation failure.
Verify generated callback retention, over-budget refusal, and no-output export failure.

changes.implementation: dx_iface estimates fixed object size, retained strings, common table-entry/XDATA values, prefix-status strings, and dynamic vector payloads before copying. Capture admits at most 100,000 records and DRW::kMaxDxfBinaryPayloadBytes logical retained bytes. Rejection or allocation failure sets a sticky dx_data flag; fileExport checks it before writing and refuses output.
changes.limits: The estimate covers logical retained content and container slots, not allocator capacity, implementation-specific list-node overhead, or process RSS.
changes.generatedTest: The adapter selector retains a generated typed AcSh object with blob, shape parameters, edges, and prefix status; it then seeds the aggregate retained-byte counter at the cap, verifies the next callback is rejected without append, and verifies export refusal publishes no DXF. No drawing fixture is used.

nonClaims: This bounds adapter-side typed capture only; it does not establish allocator-capacity or RSS bounds.
No AcSh/ACIS semantic or writer support claim is established.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
No external drawings or repository fixtures were added.
The shared worktree is extensively dirty; no staging or commit occurred.
